comment: ROMtool sanity gates (phase E4, v0.7.0). EVERY gate threshold lives here - nothing is hard-coded in romtool/sanity.py. Gates run on demand (GET /estimates/{id}/sanity) and ride the recap exports. HARD findings block the approved transition (see config/governance.json sanity_blocks_approval); warnings never do. Labor-share bands are plausibility WINDOWS per zone-letter prefix for each venue archetype (windows may overlap; a zone outside its window is a finding, not a partition assertion).

severity.severity_note: gate -> finding severity. hard findings block the approved state transition; warnings are surfaced on the sanity report and recap exports only.

labor_share_basis: share of wrapped task+foreman(N01)+super(N02) hours (mid band) across kind=='minutes' lines, grouped by catalog zone letter prefix (zone string before the first '-')
unbanded_zone_note: A zone present in the estimate but without a band entry for the archetype is reported informationally (share shown, no finding).
e_density_note: Share of labor (kind=='minutes') lines whose unit card is provenance E (estimated/placeholder). Above the threshold the recap is placeholder-heavy: the assumption register should be worked before pricing sign-off. Warning only.

unit_cost_outlier.basis: per line: wrapped labor $ mid / qty vs the norm-card unit cost (minutes_low..high mid / 60 x (tech_rate + (N01 ratio + N02 pct) x foreman_rate)). With the default crew plan the ratio equals the line's stacked factor: rope x exterior x night stacks to ~3x and flags, K-adder rows exclude the access factor so they do not self-flag.
unit_cost_outlier.note: Outlier is a verify-the-stack warning, not a math error: access x condition x schedule stacking legitimately pushes stadium roof hours past the band.

crew.note: Averages above this per crew-week (>6 x 10h days sustained) are implausible for planning: warning, not a math error.

quote_expiry_note: Quote expiry findings reuse romtool/governance.py quote date math (binding_until inclusive) and the governance.json warn threshold; severities ride the quote_expiry gate (warning).
archetype_note: An estimate definition may carry {"sanity": {"archetype": "stadium"}} (any archetype key of labor_share_by_archetype). GET /estimates/{id}/sanity?archetype=a overrides without editing the definition. With no archetype the labor-share and missing-scope gates report 'skipped' and never block.
